assertions: A deliberately locked disposable Assessor and a never-registered address both return HTTP 401.
Both paths return and render the exact same generic credential and five-attempt warning.
The locked-account response no longer enumerates account existence or lock state.

observations.message: Incorrect Email or password. Five unsuccessful attempts lock sign-in; reset your password before retrying if you are unsure.
